title: 2. Move customers to another term
note: Move Customers from a row menu: pick who moves and where, untick some, pick another term, and the result. Plus the menu for a user without the customer permissions. Light theme.

figures.heading: Choose Move Customers
captions: Rendered from the local build: Net 15 (5 customers), Move Customers hovered. Every term with customers offers it, active or inactive.
Needs Settings → Finance plus Customers → Create & Edit and View and Manage AP/AR Data; without them it shows greyed (last board).

texts.text: Rendered from the local build: Net 15 (5 customers), Move Customers hovered. Every term with customers offers it, active or inactive.
Needs Settings → Finance plus Customers → Create & Edit and View and Manage AP/AR Data; without them it shows greyed (last board).

figures.heading: Move Customers from COD
captions: Every customer on COD is listed and ticked. The Counter Sale customer is never listed and never moves.
Search narrows the list; Select All and Select None act on the customers the search shows. The count reads "{n} selected".
"Move To" is prefilled with the default for new customers (Due on Receipt) and lists every active term except the one being moved from.
The button names the count: "Move 214 Customers". Cancel closes without changes.
Title uses the 18px form-dialog title, as New Credit Term. List rows are 36px with a 1px line between them.
Source: DS Modals (form body), DS Text field, DS Checkbox, DS link buttons, DS Select.
Names and counts are demo data and differ from the build screenshots; layout, wording and states match the build (canvas-check sheets in local-check).

figures.heading: Moved
captions: Toast: "214 customers moved to Due on Receipt." COD drops to 0 customers (the Counter Sale customer stays on COD but is never counted); Due on Receipt rises from 38 to 252.

Each moved customer gets a note on its Notes, by the user who moved it: "Credit term changed from {old term} to {new term} by {user name} (Move Customers)." When its limit went from above $0 to $0, the note ends with "Credit limit {old limit} → $0." (S4-R11, S4-R20).
Invoices already created keep their term and due date. ShopView only: QuickBooks customer records are not changed, as after any customer edit today.
Names and counts are demo data and differ from the build screenshots; layout, wording and states match the build (canvas-check sheets in local-check).

figures.heading: Move To COD: the $0 line
captions: Rendered from the local build: moving from Net 7 with Move To COD (the default in this shop). Below Move To: "Prefilled with your default for new customers." and "Their credit limit will be set to $0." (S4-R7, S4-R10).
One customer is unticked, so the button reads "Move 14 Customers".

imgs.alt: Move window with Move To COD

texts.text: Move window with Move To COD

Rendered from the local build: moving from Net 7 with Move To COD (the default in this shop). Below Move To: "Prefilled with your default for new customers." and "Their credit limit will be set to $0." (S4-R7, S4-R10).

figures.heading: Confirm the $0 limits
captions: Rendered from the local build. Title "Set 14 customers' credit limit to $0?", message "This can't be undone. Their current limits are kept in each customer's note, and the Credit Terms Log records the move.", buttons Cancel and a red "Set Limits To $0 And Move" (S4-R14).

texts.text: Rendered from the local build. Title "Set 14 customers' credit limit to $0?", message "This can't be undone. Their current limits are kept in each customer's note, and the Credit Terms Log records the move.", buttons Cancel and a red "Set Limits To $0 And Move" (S4-R14).

figures.heading: Cancel keeps the choices
captions: Rendered from the local build after Cancel: back in the Move Customers window with the search, ticks (14 selected) and Move To kept (S4-R15). Nothing is moved or logged.

texts.text: Rendered from the local build after Cancel: back in the Move Customers window with the search, ticks (14 selected) and Move To kept (S4-R15). Nothing is moved or logged.

figures.heading: Without the customer permissions
captions: A user with Settings → Finance but without Customers → Create & Edit or View and Manage AP/AR Data sees Move Customers greyed in every row menu, with the hover text "You need Customers → Create & Edit and View and Manage AP/AR Data to move customers." (S4-N1). They can still make a default.
Names and counts are demo data and differ from the build screenshots; layout, wording and states match the build (canvas-check sheets in local-check).
